Booth fees

One flat fee for the whole day. Early bird takes 20% off every booth while it lasts — no other charges hiding underneath.

Booth type Regular Early bird
Food Truck / Trailer $350 $280
Food Tent 10×10 $300 $240
Desserts & Drinks 10×10 $200 $160
Bazaar / Retail 10×10 $150 $120
Nonprofit / Masjid Booth 10×10 $75 $60
Premium corner add-on Add-on +$50
Electricity add-on Add-on +$40

We never take a percentage of your sales.

Your booth fee is all you pay us. Every dollar you earn at the fest is yours.

Every fee includes

  • Your space for the full festival day
  • 1 table + 2 chairs (except food trucks)
  • Vendor parking
  • A listing and spotlight post on the fest’s social media

Simple, fair terms

  • 50% deposit holds your spot; the balance is due 14 days before the fest.
  • If we cancel, you get a full refund.
  • If you cancel 30+ days before, you get a full credit toward the next fest.
  • Food vendors need a county temporary food permit — we send the link and help you through it.
  • No hidden charges, ever.
